{{Top}}
'''Counselors''' were employed by [[Elrood Starport Command]]. They were trained to talk with [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crews about uninspired or alarming vessel names; the crew of the ''[[Blind Luck]]'' had a Counselor assigned to them upon arrival at [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] as their ship's name did not inspire confidence in the crew's competency.
